items.title: Live: Nifty marches for 5th day; broader markets outperform, Oil at $104 | Closing Bell
items.description:
Join us live for Closing Bell as we break down the action on Dalal Street through the final hour of trade and the close. The market extended its rally for the fifth straight session, with the Sensex surging around 200 points and the Nifty holding above the 23,900 mark. Market breadth was positive with advances taking the lead, and the majority of sectors ended in the green, led by metal and realty. The Midcap index extended its gains for the third day, while the Smallcap index outperformed the benchmark. IT stocks, however, stayed under pressure through the session.

On the global front, US futures turned positive as Democrats took control of Congress, and Brent crude held steady around $104 a barrel. We also track the top Nifty 50 gainers and losers, with BEL, Titan and Adani Enterprises among the gainers and TCS, Infosys and HCL Tech among the laggards, along with the key sectoral trends and the triggers that shaped the day’s trade. Stay tuned for the closing numbers, expert views and what to watch heading into the next session.
